SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, s.prototype, s.strukturbericht
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, c.element, c.atomic_fraction
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.element = 'Ni'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT ca.element AS a_site,
       cb.element AS b_site,
       COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) AS total_compounds,
       COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE) AS stable_compounds,
       COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) AS stable_percentage,
       AVG(ps.energy_above_hull) AS avg_energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition ca ON ca.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition cb ON cb.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ca.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND cb.site_label = 'B-site'
GROUP BY ca.element, cb.element
ORDER BY stable_percentage DESC, total_compounds DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, s.prototype, s.strukturbericht
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'B2' OR s.strukturbericht = 'B2'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, s.prototype, s.strukturbericht, c.element, c.atomic_fraction
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'B2' OR s.strukturbericht = 'B2')
  AND c.element = 'Zr'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
  m.formula,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'B2' OR s.strukturbericht = 'B2')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT c_a.element AS a_site,
       c_b.element AS b_site,
       COUNT(*) AS b2_compound_count,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE) AS count,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS stable_percentage,
       AVG(ps.energy_above_hull) AS avg_energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_a ON c_a.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_b ON c_b.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'B2' OR s.strukturbericht = 'B2')
  AND c_a.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND c_b.site_label = 'B-site'
GROUP BY c_a.element, c_b.element
ORDER BY stable_percentage DESC, avg_energy_above_hull ASC, b2_compound_count DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, s.prototype, s.strukturbericht
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'NaCl'
   OR s.strukturbericht = 'B1'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, c.element, c.atomic_fraction, s.prototype
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'NaCl' OR s.strukturbericht = 'B1')
  AND c.element = 'Sc'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND (s.prototype = 'NaCl' OR s.strukturbericht = 'B1' OR s.prototype = 'B1')
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT c_a.element AS a_site,
       c_b.element AS b_site,
       COUNT(*) AS nacl_compound_count,
       AVG(ps.energy_above_hull) AS avg_energy_above_hull,
       SUM(CASE WHEN ps.is_stable = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count,
       SUM(CASE WHEN ps.is_stable = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS stable_percentage
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_a ON c_a.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_b ON c_b.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'NaCl' OR s.strukturbericht = 'B1')
  AND c_a.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND c_b.site_label = 'B-site'
GROUP BY c_a.element, c_b.element
ORDER BY stable_percentage DESC, avg_energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.prototype, s.strukturbericht
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'NiAs'
   OR s.strukturbericht = 'B81'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, c.element, c.atomic_fraction, s.prototype
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Ti'
  AND s.prototype = 'NiAs'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'NiAs' OR s.strukturbericht = 'NiAs')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  c_a.element AS a_site,
  c_b.element AS b_site,
  COUNT(*) AS nias_compound_count,
  AVG(ps.energy_above_hull) AS avg_energy_above_hull,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ps.is_stable = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ps.is_stable = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS stable_percentage
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_a ON c_a.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_b ON c_b.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'NiAs'
  AND c_a.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND c_b.site_label = 'B-site'
GROUP BY c_a.element, c_b.element
ORDER BY stable_percentage DESC, avg_energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.prototype
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'BiF3'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, c.element, c.atomic_fraction, s.prototype
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Si'
  AND s.prototype = 'BiF3'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'BiF3' OR s.strukturbericht = 'BiF3')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT ca.element AS a_site,
       cb.element AS b_site,
       COUNT(*) AS bif3_combination_count,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE) AS count,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = FALSE) AS unstable_count,
       AVG(ps.energy_above_hull) AS avg_energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition ca ON ca.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition cb ON cb.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'BiF3' OR s.formula_type = 'BiF3' OR s.strukturbericht = 'BiF3')
  AND ca.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND cb.site_label = 'B-site'
GROUP BY ca.element, cb.element
ORDER BY stable_count DESC, avg_energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;
